cover: Do you need a CTO, or a CTO's judgment?

slides.title: You may not need a full-time CTO
slides.body: They need someone senior making the few technical calls a month that are expensive to get wrong.

slides.title: Hard calls get made and written down
slides.body: Rewrite or refactor, build or buy. Each decision is recorded with its tradeoffs.

slides.title: Hiring stops being a guess
slides.body: Role scoped, brief written, technical interviews run alongside the founders.

slides.title: The board gets a straight answer
slides.body: The technical update comes from someone who can answer the follow-up questions.

slides.title: It starts with a two-week audit
slides.body: A fixed-scope review of stack, team and roadmap, with written findings and no obligation.
